4. COMPREHENSIVE PROJECT CASE STUDIES (ALL 9 SHIPPED PLATFORMS)
================================================================================

PROJECT 01: Study Buddy — AI Socratic Tutor & Learning Platform for K-12 Students
- Canonical Slug: /projects/study-buddy-ai-tutor-platform
- Client: Kodevio Limited
- Role: Backend & Admin Dashboard Developer
- Status: Live (Production)
- Tech Stack: NestJS • Next.js • TypeScript • PostgreSQL • Prisma • OpenAI • Stripe • Docker
- API Documentation: https://studybuddyapi.kodevio.com/docs
- Architectural Overview:
  - Versioned NestJS REST API with 19 documented endpoint groups, Swagger specs, and unified response envelope.
  - Socratic AI tutor guiding students towards answers rather than giving direct solutions, with streaming and JSON chat modes.
  - Automatic minor detection from date of birth triggering a 5-clause parental consent workflow via email before access is granted.
  - Server-side adaptive quizzes with anti-cheat answer hiding and instant grading.
  - Free and Pro tier gating enforced server-side (daily AI quotas, custom subjects) with Stripe Checkout, webhooks, and sandbox fallback.
  - Admin dashboard for curriculum CMS, quiz management, user compliance, revenue metrics, and runtime AI tuning (temperature, safety level, model, system prompts).

PROJECT 02: MUOUZIK — Universal Music & Video Streaming Marketplace
- Canonical Slug: /projects/muouzik-music-platform
- Live Platform: https://muouzik.com
- Client: Global Client (Guinea & West Africa)
- Role: Full Stack Developer (Backend & Admin Portal)
- Tech Stack: NestJS • Next.js • Socket.io • TypeScript • AWS S3 • ChapChapPay
- Architectural Overview:
  - Versioned NestJS REST API with 13 feature modules and two Socket.IO gateways.
  - Atomic multi-track album upload (album + tracks + trailers in a single atomic transaction).
  - Mobile money checkout via ChapChapPay (Orange Money, MTN MoMo, PayCard, cards) with webhook-based fulfillment.
  - Ownership-gated audio streaming via AWS S3 SigV4 presigned URLs to prevent unauthorized downloads.
  - In-app wallet, top-ups, referral cashbacks, and coupon engine.
  - Artist verification workflow, royalty analytics, and payout approval queue.
  - Role-based admin console (Admin, Moderator, Staff) with granular permissions matrix and bilingual UI (English / French).

PROJECT 03: RoktoLagbe — Real-Time Emergency Blood Donation & Network Platform
- Canonical Slug: /projects/roktolagbe
- Live Demo: https://roktolagbe-sigma.vercel.app
- Source Code: https://github.com/mahdimonir/roktolagbe
- Role: Full Stack Developer
- Tech Stack: Next.js • TypeScript • Node.js • Express • Redis • Cloudinary
- Architectural Overview:
  - Real-time emergency blood request tracking and donor-to-hospital matchmaking.
  - Instant donor availability status and geolocation tracking.
  - Institutional dashboards for hospitals and blood banks with manager verification and audit logging.
  - Redis-backed notification engine and cached search queries for sub-50ms response times.
  - Anonymized public search protecting donor privacy while facilitating urgent contacts.
